result:
Turbonomic can help Unilever leverage AI for multi-cloud observability by providing a unified platform that monitors and optimizes applications across different cloud providers. It uses AI to analyze performance data, identify bottlenecks, and recommend actions to improve application performance and cost-efficiency.

The difference between Turbonomic and native tools from GCP, AWS, and Azure is that Turbonomic provides a single pane of glass for multi-cloud environments, whereas native tools are specific to their respective cloud providers. Turbonomic also offers more advanced AI-driven insights and recommendations for cross-cloud application performance and cost optimization.
